    index = 0

    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        edges = []
        for _ in range(n - 1):
            u = int(input[index])
            v = int(input[index + 1])
            edges.append((u, v))
            index += 2
        adj_list = defaultdict(list)
        for u, v in edges:
            adj_list[u].append(v)
            adj_list[v].append(u)
        leaves = set()
        degree = [0] * (n + 1)
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            degree[i] = len(adj_list[i])
            if degree[i] == 1:
                leaves.add(i)
        buds = set()
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            if degree[i] == 2 and all(degree[neighbor] == 1 for neighbor in adj_list[i]):
                buds.add(i)
        min_leaves = len(leaves)
        for bud in buds:
            min_leaves = min(min_leaves, len(leaves) - len(adj_list[bud]) + 1)
        results.append(str(min_leaves))
    print('\n'.join(results))
